title: Golden calcite alabaster altar of unknown origin
summary: Matt tells of Golden calcite alabaster altar of unknown origin, about ancient at Lake Van region, Turkey, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: that altar in front of you is made out of golden kisite Alabaster right and they don't even know where it came from

plain: On a show hosted by a podcaster named Jesse Michels, a researcher called Matt describes an ancient altar in the region around Lake Van in Turkey. He says it is made of golden calcite alabaster, a soft, glowing kind of stone, and that nobody even knows where the stone came from, which he offers as a hint of a lost history.
